purpose: Isolate source-scale convention, mapping complexity, noise and input effects before expanded six-target training
design_constraints: same star/dependency roles and source quality selection within each contrast
same measured-parallax input profile, encoder initialization and one fixed flexible head for mapping contrasts
FIT-only anchor and map fitting; TUNE selection; CAL separate; existing devtest is inspected development evidence
all six targets remain the large-run contract; first logg mapping contrasts can isolate atmospheric supervision before six-target integration

stages.name: reference_scale
stages.note: Last variant retains DESI temperature/iron labels. A source-ablation difference alone is not proof that DESI labels are wrong.

stages.name: mapping_complexity
stages.note: Run only under the best-supported anchored scale; unconstrained source NN is not the default.

stages.name: external_validation
sources: TESS and K2 staged, identity bridges pending
stages.note: Retain source calibration/teacher dependencies and protect validation subsets before fitting anchors.

decisions.physical_scale: Do not interpret equal-weight zero-sum survey convention as physical calibration
decisions.forward_model: source-specific observed subset of h_s(theta_six,q_s) with source error and discrepancy; learn only supported source-target edges
decisions.function_class: nested offsets/affine/monotone spline candidates; final flexibility selected by ablation
decisions.propagation: exact forward sample propagation preferred for nonlinear sample-based scoring; retain affine surrogate as explicit control
decisions.uncertainty: include source discrepancy and mapping uncertainty; distinguish latent predictive uncertainty from observation noise
decisions.six_target_status: not yet implemented or fitted in the current mapped three-target checkpoint

label_error_model.systematic_bias: source-specific forward calibration h_s; anchored physical scale
label_error_model.within_source_noise: full covariance among jointly estimated observed targets, retaining published covariance when supplied
label_error_model.covariance_when_unpublished: Unknown covariance: test a regularized source/domain covariance against the diagonal control using repeats, overlaps and anchors. Keep the simpler model if added covariance fails held-out validation.
label_error_model.catastrophic_failures: explicit robust inlier/outlier mixture or heavy-tailed measurement model with source quality dependence
label_error_model.cross_source_dependence: shared per-star/random effects or block covariance for shared inputs, teachers, spectra and calibration; do not multiply dependent products as independent evidence
label_error_model.covariance_components: distinguish quoted measurement uncertainty, residual survey discrepancy, calibration-function uncertainty and stellar predictive uncertainty
label_error_model.missing_targets: select observed covariance submatrix; missing errors are not zero errors
label_error_model.posterior_teachers: age/distance posterior widths are not independent Gaussian label errors; retain priors and shared-input dependence
validation: same-star cross-source residual covariance with dependencies modeled
check whether uncertainty is incorrectly absorbed by maps or intrinsic stellar spread

reconstruction_decision.default: retain MAE reconstruction and current 0.03 weight for mapping/noise contrasts
reconstruction_decision.prior_evidence: User reports correlated XP Gaussian-NLL reconstruction did not improve results and MAE performed better; this is distinct from label-noise covariance.
reconstruction_decision.current_wave: All eight controlled arms held the reconstruction recipe fixed; this wave does not compare reconstruction losses.
